fix(core-v2): repair FROZEN to RELEASED checkpoint contract

Addresses #494.

- Build and bind deterministic CORE_STAGE_CONTRACT report in survey_release_checkpoint_v2.py
- Preserve independent RELEASE_EXACT_BYTE_RECONCILIATION deterministic review
- Enforce dual deterministic authority (CORE_STAGE_CONTRACT + RELEASE_EXACT_BYTE_RECONCILIATION) in stage-checkpoint-v2.schema.json and advance_with_checkpoint()
- Remove historical skip for FROZEN in _validate_checkpoint_record()
- Add comprehensive regression test suite covering missing/drifted authorities, idempotency, and clean terminal progression
- Keep W34 frozen and released bytes completely untouched

fix(core-v2): add pre-publication reader-surface gate (#434)

Implement fail-fast pre-publication reader-surface validation to prevent
internal production, architecture, screening, and review language from
leaking into reader-facing prose before TeX compilation, manifest creation,
and candidate assembly.

- Add schemas/reader-surface-gate-v2.schema.json
- Add scripts/survey_reader_surface_gate_v2.py with deterministic lexical
  linter, TeX/BibTeX scanner, narrow allowlist engine, and semantic layer
- Integrate reader-surface gate into scripts/survey_reader_publication_v2.py,
  scripts/survey_longform_publication_v2.py,
  scripts/survey_weekly_semantic_publication_v2.py, and
  scripts/survey_stage_validation_v2.py
- Add tests/test_survey_reader_surface_gate_v2.py with 9 comprehensive tests
- Clean fixture text in tests/test_survey_human_gate_v2.py

Merge pull request #495 from eariver/fix/core-v2-release-stage-contract-20260914

fix(core-v2): address Sol review findings on pre-publication reader-surface gate (Issue #434)

- Weekly reader-facing synthesis: require authoritative publication_payload,
  refusing fallback to internal profile_payload.current_interpretation.
- Semantic reader-facing review: enforce mandatory machine-checkable semantic
  PASS review authority bound to exact reader-facing surface bytes (surface_sha256).
- Applicable publication boundary: require reader-surface-gate artifact at
  DRAFT_COMPLETE and VALIDATED_DRAFT stage validations.
- Independent re-validator: implement validate_reader_surface_gate verifying
  gate_sha256 digest, scanned surface bytes/SHA on disk, required semantic authority,
  and profile/issue identity, plus validate-gate CLI command.
- Gate ordering: validate canonical structured reader-facing payload (closing
  synthesis and draft blocks) before TeX materialization.
- Update and expand test coverage for all 5 review findings.
